name: Autodesk Education
summary: Free one-year access to AutoCAD, Revit, Civil 3D, Fusion, Inventor and more for study.
key: Free, single-user, one-year access. Renew each year while you are eligible.
who: Students at a qualified educational institution who meet Autodesk's minimum age requirement.
how: Pick a product on the Autodesk Education page to start verification.
Once you're verified, download the software with your existing Autodesk account.
Renew from 30 days before your access expires.
catches: For learning, training and research only. It may not be used for commercial, professional or any other for-profit purpose.
Install on up to three devices.
Some add-ons need other subscriptions. For example, cloud worksharing needs Revit or Civil 3D plus Forma.
need: Proof of enrolment if SheerID, Autodesk's verification provider, asks for it.
open_questions: The minimum age is in a linked PDF that wasn't checked.
